turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, it was actually a really easy trip today. I drove my hybrid in, and luckily the traffic on the way to the clinic wasn't bad at all.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's always a relief, especially for a day shift. Did you manage to get a decent break for lunch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I brought a homemade bowl with rice, beans, fajita veggies, and salsa that I put together at home. It was nice to have something filling ready to go in the breakroom.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious and super convenient. Did you have any good entertainment for your drive in today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually listened to that unsolved mystery series my colleague suggested a while back. It's all about cold cases, and I got so sucked into the story that the drive flew by.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, those cold case shows can be so addictive! I'm glad you're enjoying it. Speaking of big things, how are you and Tom doing? Any new updates on the wedding plans for summer 2028?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're doing well! No major updates, honestly. Tom and I are still keeping our eyes on that summer 2028 date, but we're just enjoying the engagement and not rushing into the heavy planning quite yet.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very healthy approach. No need to stress yourselves out early. Have you had any time for your sourdough baking lately, or has work kept you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually fed my starter yesterday! I'm hoping to bake a fresh boule this weekend if I can find the time between my shifts. Sourdough is always my go-to way to unwind.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: There really is nothing like the smell of fresh bread. I hope it turns out great! How is Dash doing? Is he keeping you company while you prep your dough?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Dash is wonderful. He mostly just sleeps on his bed near the kitchen, occasionally opening one eye to see if any crumbs fall. He's the best baking companion.
